"'''Mafia Boss Music'''" <ref>[http://www.olbapmusic.com/ "Mafia Boss Music" on Michael Hunter's website]</ref> is the theme song of [[Salvatore Leone]] in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]'', used in [[The Introduction]] short film.

==Description==
It is composed and produced by [[Michael Hunter]] in [[2004]]. The song was first featured in The Introduction short film, in the cutscene where [[Johnny Sindacco]] wants Salvatore Leone to invest $5,000,000 in the [[Sindacco Crime Family|Sindaccos]]' [[Caligula's Palace|casino]].
